invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: Manage your gig invitations from brands.
invitations.noInvitationsDesc: When brands invite you to their gigs, they will appear here.

dialogs.acceptDesc: Are you sure you want to accept this invitation? This will notify the brand and you can start working on the gig.
dialogs.acceptCommentPlaceholder: Add a comment for this approval
dialogs.declineDesc: Are you sure you want to decline this invitation? This action cannot be undone.
dialogs.rejectDesc: Are you sure you want to reject this invitation? This action cannot be undone.
